description: A utility module for recipe scraping, including functions for parsing fractions, durations, yields, and cleaning strings, as well as handling URLs and method introspection.

methods.name: format_diet_name
methods.description: Normalizes diet names, replacing schema.org references and known diet types with user-friendly labels.

methods.name: _extract_fractional
methods.description: Converts a string representing a fraction or mixed number into a float.

methods.name: get_minutes
methods.description: Extracts total minutes from a time string or ISO8601 duration.

methods.name: get_yields
methods.description: Determines the yield of a recipe in terms of servings, items, or other units, based on input element.

methods.name: get_equipment
methods.description: Removes duplicates and sorts equipment items.

methods.name: normalize_string
methods.description: Unescapes HTML entities, removes HTML tags, and cleans whitespace from a string.

methods.name: csv_to_tags
methods.description: Converts a comma-separated string into a list of tags, optionally lowercased.

methods.name: url_path_to_dict
methods.description: Parses a URL into its components using regex.

methods.name: get_host_name
methods.description: Extracts the hostname from a URL.

methods.name: change_keys
methods.description: Recursively replaces dictionary keys using a conversion function.

methods.name: get_url_slug
methods.description: Extracts the last segment of the URL path.

methods.name: get_abstract_methods
methods.description: Returns a list of method names from the AbstractScraper class, excluding private and certain special methods.

methods.name: get_nutrition_keys
methods.description: Returns a list of nutrition-related keys.
